stops.name: Altmühltal Dinosaur Museum
stops.quote: Little amateur archaeologists will be sure to get to the bottom of these and other questions in the primaeval forest of the Altmühltal Dinosaur Museum
stops.english: Little amateur archaeologists will be sure to get to the bottom of these and other questions in the primaeval forest of the Altmühltal Dinosaur Museum

stops.name: Dinopark
stops.quote: Children can experience science through play at the Dinopark near Denkendorf in the Altmühltal Valley Nature Park.
stops.english: Children can experience science through play at the Dinopark near Denkendorf in the Altmühltal Valley Nature Park.

stops.name: museum hall
stops.quote: You can admire both dinos in the museum hall.
stops.english: You can admire both dinos in the museum hall.

stops.name: adventure trail
stops.quote: Outdoors, a one-and-a-half-kilometre-long adventure trail brings the giants of prehistory close enough for young and old to touch.
stops.english: Outdoors, a one-and-a-half-kilometre-long adventure trail brings the giants of prehistory close enough for young and old to touch.

stops.name: Hands-on Hall
stops.quote: A wide range of stations in the “Hands-on Hall” – such as the search for fossil shark teeth or the uncovering of a Diplodocus skeleton – will inspire the children and encourage them to explore and discover.
stops.english: A wide range of stations in the “Hands-on Hall” – such as the search for fossil shark teeth or the uncovering of a Diplodocus skeleton – will inspire the children and encourage them to explore and discover.

stops.name: restaurant by the lake
stops.quote: When it’s time for a break, there is the restaurant by the lake or the secluded forest beer garden.
stops.english: When it’s time for a break, there is the restaurant by the lake or the secluded forest beer garden.

stops.name: forest beer garden
stops.quote: They offer delicious organic dishes, as well as vegetarian and vegan alternatives.
stops.english: They offer delicious organic dishes, as well as vegetarian and vegan alternatives.
